generator_rejection: Complete banks are filtered for five distinct nonzero integer pairs and all coefficients <=9 before selecting a correct role. Background resampling retains the bank, role, pivot and row. There is no role-dependent rejection or output truncation.
learner_selection_code: engine/rust/question_selection.rs: select receives already-fresh/usable candidates, weights difficulty bands, then selects within a band using a deterministic hash. These generated records all have easy difficulty; this function does not inspect choice components. seen_before_task excludes prior task contents.
